verdict.rationale: The README states the skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md) and so works in any agent that supports skills. It also frames the skill as usable by Claude or any Agent Skills–compatible agent, and it installs by copying the skill folder into a skills directory. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that it runs in non-Claude agents, and documentation of spec conformance or validation (install instructions shown are mostly Claude-specific, e.g. the plugin marketplace and Settings upload).
